data.name: Erinna
data.gender_notes: Erinna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Erinna was a goddess of love and spring. Her name is derived from eros (love) and nymphe (young girl). The name Erinna carries the meaning “Goddess of love and spring” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erinna usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and spring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of love, renewal, and growth.
data.etymology: Erinna belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of love and spring.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Erinna total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: ארinna
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו שלום או נחמה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ארinna הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו ביוונית ופירושו שלום או נחמה. הוא קשור למושגים של רוגע ושלווה בתרבות הנוצרית. השם משמש לעתים קרובות כאמצעי לבטא את השאיפה לשלווה פנימית ולנחמה רוחנית.

in_greek.name: Εριννα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εριννα έχει τις ρίζες του στην ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει ειρήνη ή παρηγορία. Στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία Χριστιανική, το όνομα αυτό πιθανότατα να χρησιμοποιούταν για να εκφράσει την επιθυμία για πνευματική γαλήνη και παρηγορία. Η Εριννα συνδέεται με έννοιες της αρμονίας και της ηρεμίας.

in_latin.name: Erinna
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Erinna, derived from Greek roots, signifies peace or consolation in Latin. In early Christian tradition, it was used to express a longing for inner peace and spiritual comfort. The name carries connotations of serenity and solace.

in_english.name: Erinna
in_english.long_meaning: The name Erinna, originating from Greek roots, means peaceful or comforting. Etymologically linked to concepts of peace and consolation, Erinna has been used in Christian traditions to signify a desire for inner tranquility and spiritual solace. Historically, the name may not be directly mentioned in biblical texts but carries significant spiritual meaning in the context of Christian culture. It symbolizes serenity, calmness, and a deep sense of comfort.
